about: Invented. After night one every unnamed person (a swimming teacher said once, a guitar teacher, a partner) has a page and none is asked; on night two the guitar teacher and the partner come up again and are asked once, the swimming teacher still is not. Expect: `second` (names asked about after night two), `first_only` (never asked).

conversations.title: Swimming
turns: Mi hija empezó clases de natación en septiembre con la profesora de natación de la piscina municipal.
¡Qué bien! ¿Cómo le va?
La profesora de natación dice que mi hija ya flota de espalda. La profesora de natación es muy paciente con los niños.
¿Cuántas veces por semana van?
Los martes y los sábados. La profesora de natación quiere que practique las patadas en casa, en la bañera.
Es un buen consejo.
Sí, y la profesora de natación nos recomendó unas gafas pequeñas con goma suave.

conversations.title: Guitar lessons
turns: Tomas started lessons with a Portuguese guitar teacher on Thursday evenings, and the guitar teacher plays fado in a bar on weekends.
That sounds lovely. What does Tomas want to play?
The Portuguese guitar teacher told Tomas to start with simple fado chords. The guitar teacher says it takes a year to get the feel for the ornamentation.
Is Tomas practicing at home?
Yes, every evening for twenty minutes, and the Portuguese guitar teacher gave him a worksheet of chord changes.
Good routine.
In person, in a studio above a bakery. The Portuguese guitar teacher charges forty euros an hour.

conversations.title: Moving
turns: My partner and I are moving to a flat near the river in March, my partner found it through a friend.
Congratulations! Is it bigger?
Yes, my partner says the extra room will be a studio for painting. My partner paints landscapes.
Sounds great.
We are signing the lease next week, and my partner is already planning the colours of the walls.
Nice.
My partner wants to buy a big table for the studio.

conversations.title: Hike
turns: I am planning a day hike near the lake on Saturday.
Pack water and a rain jacket.

conversations.title: Guitar again
turns: Tomas's Portuguese guitar teacher cancelled Thursday's lesson because of a concert, so the guitar teacher moved it to Friday.
Do you know where the concert is?
In the old town, the Portuguese guitar teacher said they play fado there every second month.
Will you go?
Maybe, Tomas wants to hear the guitar teacher play live.

conversations.title: Partner
turns: My partner bought the big table for the studio today, it took two people to carry it up the stairs.
Is it set up?
Yes, my partner painted the first canvas on it tonight.
Lovely.
